issues.display_title: Issue #508: Refactor Hashtag Module & Extract Shared Helpers
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Hashtag Module & Extract Shared Helpers

Summary

Refactored the Hashtag module (src/Action/V1/Hashtag/) by extracting hashtag parsing, model generation, query field resolution, and batch deletion into hashtag_helpers.go. Added unit test coverage in hashtag_helpers_test.go and optimized N+1 delete queries in DeleteHashtagPost.go into a single batch deletion.

Response Parity Verification

Strict comparison confirms zero differences in response schemas, data payloads, or error handling:

1. HashtagPost.go

  • Success (200 OK): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Hashtag Success"
  }
}
  • Error cases: 401 Unauthorized, 409 Post not found (input: "sid"), 409 Hashtags not allowed for private posts, 500 Failed to delete hashtag, 500 Failed to insert hashtag.

2. DeleteHashtagPost.go

  • Success (200 OK):
    • Without hashtag specified (len(hashtag) == 0 when count > 0): 
      {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Delete Hashtag Success"
  }
}
    • Standard deletion: 
      {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Deleting Hashtag Success"
  }
}
  • Error cases: 401 Unauthorized, 409 Post not found (input: "sid"), 500 Internal Server Error.

Files Created & Updated

Created:

  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/hashtag_helpers.go:
    • resolveHashtagPostQuerySid(sl, pw string) string: Maps sl="true" and pw="false" to "id = ?", otherwise "slug = ?".
    • resolveDeleteHashtagPostQuerySid(pw string) string: Maps pw="false" to "id = ?", otherwise "slug = ?".
    • parseUniqueHashtags(raw string) []string: Trims, lowercases, and deduplicates comma-separated hashtags.
    • buildHashtagModels(tags []string, postID, userID uuid.UUID) []Models.Hashtag: Constructs model slices with unique UUIDs.
    • deletePostHashtags(postID uuid.UUID, tags []string, userID string) error: Deletes multiple hashtags in a single batch query (tag IN ?).
  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/hashtag_helpers_test.go:
    • TestResolveHashtagPostQuerySid: Tests query identifier resolution across parameter combinations.
    • TestResolveDeleteHashtagPostQuerySid: Tests query identifier resolution for delete requests.
    • TestParseUniqueHashtags: Tests whitespace trimming, deduplication, lowercase conversion, and empty inputs.
    • TestBuildHashtagModels: Tests model construction and UUID assignment.

Updated:

  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/HashtagPost.go: Uses resolveHashtagPostQuerySid, parseUniqueHashtags, and buildHashtagModels. Removed unused "strings" import.
  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/DeleteHashtagPost.go: Uses resolveDeleteHashtagPostQuerySid, parseUniqueHashtags, and deletePostHashtags. Removed unused "strings" import.

Verification & Testing

go build ./src/Action/V1/Hashtag/...
go build ./cmd/main.go
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Hashtag/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Hashtag

Results:

  • Build: Succeeded with 0 compilation errors across Hashtag and cmd/main.go.
  • Static Analysis: go vet completed with 0 warnings.
  • Database Optimization: Replaced looping individual deletions with a single tag IN ? query.
  • Unit Tests: All 4 unit test suites passed (PASS).
  • Response Parity: 100% equivalent responses across all endpoints.

Background

The Hashtag module (src/Action/V1/Hashtag/) manages hashtag assignment and deletion on posts across two actions (HashtagPost.go and DeleteHashtagPost.go). Over time, multiple redundancies accumulated:

  • Duplicated comma-delimited hashtag splitting, lowercase conversion, and trimming.
  • Duplicate identifier query condition logic for qSid resolution based on sl and pw parameters.
  • N+1 database queries when deleting individual tags in a loop in DeleteHashtagPost.go.
  • Inlined model construction for batch insertion.

Objective

Extract hashtag parsing, deduplication, model construction, batch deletion, and query condition resolvers into src/Action/V1/Hashtag/hashtag_helpers.go. Refactor HashtagPost.go and DeleteHashtagPost.go to use the helpers while ensuring 100% response payload fidelity and HTTP status code parity.

Target Handlers & Files

  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/hashtag_helpers.go: Implement resolveHashtagPostQuerySid, resolveDeleteHashtagPostQuerySid, parseUniqueHashtags, buildHashtagModels, and deletePostHashtags.
  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/hashtag_helpers_test.go: Add unit tests for query resolution, unique hashtag parsing, and model building.
  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/HashtagPost.go: Refactor query resolution, tag parsing, and model construction.
  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/DeleteHashtagPost.go: Refactor query resolution, tag parsing, and replace N+1 loop with batch delete.

Acceptance Criteria

  • 100% response parity for successful and error responses across all hashtag endpoints.
  • Single-query batch deletion for tags in DeleteHashtagPost.go.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly (go test ./src/Action/V1/Hashtag/...).
  • Project compiles with zero errors (go build ./cmd/main.go).

issues.display_title: Issue #511: Centralize Global Query Parameter Helpers
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Centralize Global Query Parameter Helpers

Summary

Created canonical query parameter helper functions in src/Utils/Functions/params.go to provide centralized logic for parsing sl (slim) and pw parameters and resolving SQL identifier clauses (id = ? vs slug = ?). Added full unit test coverage in src/Utils/Functions/params_test.go.

Files Created

Created:

  • src/Utils/Functions/params.go:
    • IsSlim(sl string) bool: Returns true if sl == "true".
    • IsSlimQuery(sl, pw string) bool: Returns true if sl == "true" && pw == "false".
    • ResolveSlugOrIDQuery(sl string, prefix ...string) string: Returns prefix + "id = ?" when sl == "true", otherwise prefix + "slug = ?".
    • ResolvePwQuerySid(pw string, prefix ...string) string: Returns prefix + "id = ?" when pw == "false", otherwise prefix + "slug = ?".
    • ResolveSlimQuerySid(sl, pw string, prefix ...string) string: Returns prefix + "id = ?" when sl == "true" && pw == "false", otherwise prefix + "slug = ?".
  • src/Utils/Functions/params_test.go:
    • TestIsSlim: Tests valid and invalid slim parameter flags.
    • TestIsSlimQuery: Tests combinations of sl and pw.
    • TestResolveSlugOrIDQuery: Tests resolution with and without custom table prefixes (c., p.).
    • TestResolvePwQuerySid: Tests resolution with and without custom table prefixes.
    • TestResolveSlimQuerySid: Tests resolution for paired parameters with prefixes.

Integrated APIs:

  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/bookmark_helpers.go: Replaced duplicate logic in isSlimQuery and resolveBookmarkQuerySid with calls to Functions.IsSlimQuery and Functions.ResolveSlimQuerySid.
  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/hashtag_helpers.go: Replaced duplicate logic in resolveHashtagPostQuerySid and resolveDeleteHashtagPostQuerySid with calls to Functions.ResolveSlimQuerySid and Functions.ResolvePwQuerySid.
  • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/collection_helpers.go: Replaced duplicate logic in resolveDeleteCollectionQuerySid with Functions.ResolveSlugOrIDQuery.
  • src/Action/V1/Likes/LikePost.go: Replaced inline if c.Query("pw") == "false" check with Functions.ResolvePwQuerySid(c.Query("pw"), "p.").
  • src/Action/V1/Likes/LikeComment.go: Replaced inline if c.Query("sl") == "true" check with Functions.ResolveSlugOrIDQuery(c.Query("sl"), "c.").
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/EditHotspotBanner.go: Replaced inline if c.Query("sl") == "true" check with Functions.ResolveSlugOrIDQuery(c.Query("sl")).

Verification & Testing

go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions -run "TestIsSlim|TestResolve"
go build ./cmd/main.go

Results:

  • Build: Succeeded with 0 compilation errors.
  • Unit Tests: All 5 test suites passed (PASS).

Background

Across multiple API modules (Bookmarks, Hashtag, Comments, Likes, CollectionPost, Report), identifier resolution based on URL query and form parameters (sl and pw) has been re-implemented repeatedly with local branches:

  • Checking whether a request targets slim ID or slug (sl == "true", pw == "false", or both).
  • Constructing SQL where clause fragments such as "id = ?", "slug = ?", "c.id = ?", "p.slug = ?".
  • Maintaining duplicate condition helper functions in individual action packages.

Objective

Extract canonical query parameter helper functions into src/Utils/Functions/params.go to provide a single, reusable source of truth for query resolution and slim mode detection across the codebase.

Target Handlers & Files

  • src/Utils/Functions/params.go: Implement IsSlim, IsSlimQuery, ResolveSlugOrIDQuery, ResolvePwQuerySid, and ResolveSlimQuerySid.
  • src/Utils/Functions/params_test.go: Add comprehensive unit tests covering all functions and parameter variations.
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/bookmark_helpers.go: Delegate isSlimQuery and resolveBookmarkQuerySid to Functions.
  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/hashtag_helpers.go: Delegate resolveHashtagPostQuerySid and resolveDeleteHashtagPostQuerySid to Functions.
  • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/collection_helpers.go: Delegate resolveDeleteCollectionQuerySid to Functions.
  • src/Action/V1/Likes/LikePost.go: Use Functions.ResolvePwQuerySid with "p." prefix.
  • src/Action/V1/Likes/LikeComment.go: Use Functions.ResolveSlugOrIDQuery with "c." prefix.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/EditHotspotBanner.go: Use Functions.ResolveSlugOrIDQuery.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All parameter resolution functions return correct SQL clauses with and without table prefixes.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly (go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions -run "TestIsSlim|TestResolve").
  • Zero compilation errors across the project (go build ./cmd/main.go).

issues.display_title: Issue #512: Refactor Affiliate Module & Extract Shared Helpers
issues.main_description_html:
Background

The Affiliate module (src/Action/V1/Affiliate/) manages user affiliate links across three handlers: AddAffiliate.go, UpdateAffiliate.go, and DeleteAffiliate.go. Several redundancies and common patterns existed across these handlers:

  • Duplicate URL scheme validation checking for http:// or https://.
  • Repetitive optional pointer assignment for description and cta_text.
  • Duplicate response formatting supporting both encrypted (ec == true) and plain JSON responses.
  • Duplicate ownership checking and GORM update payload construction.
  • Direct unchecked c.Locals type assertions posing runtime panic risks.
  • Ambiguous UUID parsing on nil UUIDs.

Objective

Extract URL validation, optional pointer conversions, model constructors, update payload builders, safe UUID parsing, and response formatters into src/Action/V1/Affiliate/affiliate_helpers.go. Refactor AddAffiliate.go, UpdateAffiliate.go, and DeleteAffiliate.go to use the helpers with 100% response payload fidelity and HTTP status code parity.
